rules.where: NVL(ST_SRV_ASST_FLAG, 0) != 4 AND ((SUPPLIER_CODE >= (SELECT FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) AND SUPPLIER_CODE <= (SELECT TO_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) OR :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0)

validations.name: lot transferred to the stores is read-only

after_save.name: lines required, supplier expenses <= lot freight
delete: refuse posted lots, remove details

PR_INCOME_LOT.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where nvl(effect, 0) = 7 and nvl(trns_type, 0) = 15 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

PR_INCOME_LOT.STORE_CODE.lov: select store_code || ' - ' || name_a d, store_code r from st_store where store_status = 1 and nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

PR_INCOME_LOT.SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

PR_INCOME_DET_EXPENS.SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from supplier where (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by code

PR_INCOME_LOT_DET.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

AS_ASSET_ACCT_TOT.ASSET_ACCT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

AS_ASSET_ACCT_TOT.COST_CODE.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

PR_INCOME_LOT_DET.ITEM_NAME_A.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.group_code)

PR_INCOME_LOT_SRVC.SERVICE_NAME.sql: (select max(s.name_a) from st_pu_services s where s.service_code = t.service_code)

PR_INCOME_LOT_ASST.DESC_A_ASCT.sql: (select max(c.desc_a_asct) from as_ctgry c where c.ctgry_cd_asct = t.ctgry_cd_asst)
